question: What is the name of the year-long "Cleanliness Drive" launched in Aizawl, Mizoram?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Hnatlangpui**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Mizoram Launches Year-Long ‘Hnatlangpui’ Cleanliness Drive in Aizawl.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**"Hnatlangpui"** is a year-long cleanliness drive launched in **Aizawl, Mizoram** to improve sanitation and waste management.

 
 
• 
 
The drive is a joint effort of the **Urban Development & Poverty Alleviation Department**, **Aizawl Municipal Corporation (AMC)**, and **Central Young Mizo Association (CYMA)**.

 
 
• 
 
The government is setting up a **Common Biomedical Waste Treatment Facility** to support the cleanliness campaign in hospitals and healthcare centers.

 
 
• 
 
The initiative aims to address critical issues such as **biomedical waste** management and improve the overall cleanliness of Aizawl.
